_marker: THE NAMED DIVERGENCES — every place the documented chain does NOT re-derive the committed corpus, with the reviewed cause. Read by scripts/corpus-reproducible-check.ts: an UNNAMED divergence refuses, and a row whose divergence has since been FIXED refuses too (a stale row is as dead as a missing one). Rows are not permission to drift — they are the admission, on the record, that a fact in the corpus came from somewhere the chain cannot reach.

polaris.cause: HAND-EDITED PROMOTED CONTRACTS WITH NO AUTHORED-FACTS LEDGER. polaris is the one library whose ds-library.json names no `authored` file, and eight of its committed contracts carry edits the promoter does not produce: developed defaults (avatar `initials: "TP"` and `withInitials: true`, progress-bar `progress: 40`), FC-ENUM-HOLE (button `tone` gains the developed `default` value and its `{variant}.none` paint paths), FC-SVG-ROTATION (spinner glyphs gain `transform: rotate(90deg)`), console-loop VISUAL fixes (checkbox/radio-button backdrops swap minted `tokensByProp` for literal per-axis border+fill; the indeterminate glyph's `fill` is rebound to icon-6 white), a changed sample string (checkbox "Save this product" -> "Save this information"), and pruned/added minted leaves that follow from those. Each edit names its own cause inline in the contract, so none of them is a mystery about WHAT — but none of them is an INPUT, so the chain cannot produce them and `promote-generalization` has never covered polaris. The door that would carry them already exists (packages/cli/src/promote.ts authored facts: `edit` for the enum/default/description moves, `set.fields` for `literalsByProp` and `meter`, `set.declared` for the glyph rotation, `add` for the FC-ENUM-HOLE enum value, `prune` for the leaves that go orphan). Routing them is a bounded, mechanical round of its own and is NOT done here; this row exists so the gap is machine-checked rather than silent.

mui/tooltip.cause: THE CAPTURE REFUSES ITSELF — the sharpest row in this ledger, and an HONEST refusal by the engine's own determinism self-check. MUI's Tooltip mounts a Popper whose x offset is computed from the trigger's measured position, and two sweeps of the SAME configuration in one session disagree by 3px (19 vs 16). `extract/computed/run.ts` requires double-run byte-identity and stops. So `extract/computed/out/mui/tooltip` cannot be re-derived by anyone, on any machine, today — not because a fact was hand-written, but because the subject is not deterministic under the documented recipe. Cure: pin the Popper's placement in the capture config (a fixed anchor, the way the openDriver already pins `open`) so the offset stops being a function of layout timing, then recapture. Until then this record is a measurement nobody can repeat, and this row says so.
